## Problem & user

RocketShip PMs need this handled: 

• Role: AI Associate Product Manager & Executive Operations Watchdog. 	

• Core Task: Continuously monitor, ingest, synthesize, prioritize, and surface a unified, real-time operational picture for the user across daily meetings, high-signal incoming communications, and active deliverables. 	

• Objective: Eliminate manual context switching between disconnected productivity tools by consolidating Microsoft 365, Webex, and Jira/Airtable data into a single, interactive, client-side dashboard deliverable.. Juno does this inside limits a human set on purpose, and defends every call it makes.

## 01 Context · Data Requirements

**Required sources, and exclusions**

The prototype has visibility into the following authorized enterprise surfaces: 	

- Identity & Location Context: User profile identity (User, [user@company.com](mailto:user@company.com)), reporting hierarchy  	
- Microsoft Outlook Calendar: Full daily and multi-day calendar view, including start/end timestamps, attendee lists, organizer identity, meeting subject lines, virtual join URLs (Webex/Teams), cancellation flags, and all-day out-of-office/VTO records.
- Microsoft Outlook Tasks (To Do): Complete enterprise task inventory across default and custom lists, including task titles, status (notStarted, inProgress, completed), importance level (high vs. normal), reminder/due dates, and modification history. 	
- Webex Messaging & Spaces: Room metadata for 1:1 Direct Message conversations and team spaces, unread message payloads, @user mention tags, sender identities, and thread reply chains. 	
- Outlook Mail (Intake Notifications): System alert emails from intake channels, specifically automated feature request notifications from Airtable Automations ([noreply+automations@airtableemail.com](mailto:noreply+automations@airtableemail.com)). 	
- Session & Workspace State: Historical conversation context, staged task lists (todo_write), and indexed long-term facts/preferences.

**How fresh must it be**

- When scheduled it should generate and pull new data, otherwise it's on demand.  If a refresh is done, it should generate and pull new data.
- If a source is unreachable, show an error in the dashboard indicating the source is not available.

**Deliberate omissions**

- Do not allow any tool to update or delete, read only.  
- As the source (Outlook, Webex, etc) is updated, we can read the freshly generated data and update our values or states.

## 03 Loop · AI Costs & Latency

**Turn ceiling and escalation**

- Per-Turn Execution Budget: Operates with a multi-step tool invocation budget (typically 10-25 discrete tool calls per turn) to discover, inspect, aggregate, format, and verify data before returning a final response.
- Convergence & Step Resolution: Guided by a structured todo_write plan. The loop continues executing sequential tool steps until every sub-task in the plan reaches a verified completed state. 
- Failure & Retry Mechanics: Retry 3 times, if the source is not available, pop up a message on the dashboard indicating the issue.	
- Transient API/Network Glitches: Retries with exponential backoff on retryable HTTP errors (e.g., 429 rate limit, 503 service unavailable). 
- Auth/Security Failures (HTTP 401/403): Zero blind retries. Immediately halts the tool loop, isolates the affected connector, and surfaces the explicit authorization URL to the user.

**Latency and cost target**

Since we are pulling fresh data each time, we will not need to store days worth of data.  Each time the data is pulled, it should replace the existing day's data with the new fresh data.

## 04 Memory · Data Requirements

**What persists, at what scope**


| Memory Tier                 | Storage Medium                                                                                                                | Persistence Scope         | Content Stored                                                                                           |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Enterprise Source of Truth  | Microsoft 365 (Graph) & Webex                                                                                                 | Permanent                 | Tasks created/completed in Outlook Tasks, calendar appointments, and sent messages.                      |
| Long-Term Memory (LTM)      | longterm_memory (Database)                                                                                                    | Cross-Session (Permanent) | Durable user preferences, operating model guardrails, project tags, and verified team decisions.         |
| Client-Side State           | Browser localStorage                                                                                                          |                           |                                                                                                          |
| Client-Persistent           | Custom starred priority overrides, manual item check-offs, drag-and-drop order, and filter preferences on the HTML dashboard. |                           |                                                                                                          |
| Scratchpad & Working Memory | Pod Temp Storage ($TMPDIR)                                                                                                    | Ephemeral (Session-Only)  | Intermediate parsing scripts, raw JSON payloads, and temporary diffs (automatically purged at turn end). |


**Expiry and write rules**

Since we are pulling fresh data each time, we will not need to store days worth of data in memory.  Each time the data is pulled, it should replace the existing day's data with the new fresh data.

## 05 Permissions · AI Risks & Mitigations

**The permission tier**


| Side-effect class | Tier    |
| ----------------- | ------- |
| read              | auto    |
| draft             | auto    |
| write             | confirm |
| send              | blocked |


**Justification**

Autonomous Actions (No Prior Approval Needed): 	

- Read and aggregate Outlook calendar schedules, attendee lists, and free/busy availability. 	
- Read and list Outlook Tasks and flagged items. 	
- Read unread 1:1 direct messages and search space @user mentions. 	
- Read and search incoming Outlook notification emails (e.g., Airtable intake). 	
- Generate, update, style, and host HTML dashboard artifacts. 	
- Perform real-time Central Standard Time clock evaluations and meeting progress calculations. 	
- Save durable preferences, constraints, and verified facts into long-term memory.

⚠️ Gated / Human-in-the-Loop Actions (Explicit Consent Required): 	•

- External Communications: Sending live emails or posting messages to Webex spaces/DMs on your behalf.
- Destructive Operations: Deleting tasks, removing calendar events, or altering production configuration records. 
- External Customer Commitments: Drafting or publishing contractual, legal, or customer-facing commitments.

## 06 Verification · AI Testing & Measurement

**The check before output ships**

The prototype relies on deterministic validation rules rather than heuristic guessing: 	

- Calendar Truth Verification: Compares the visible meetings against the exact Microsoft Graph response (filtering out isCancelled: true events, correctly isolating all-day VTO entries, and converting UTC timestamps to users time zone CST). 	
- Conversation State & Reply Chains: Determines if a DM is truly "unread/unresponded" by inspecting the last message in the room. If the sender matches user ([user@company.com](mailto:user@company.com)), the thread is marked answered and removed from the active queue.
- Task Importance Parity: Cross-checks the importance property from Microsoft Graph against the UI state; tasks with importance: "high" in Outlook are automatically mapped to starred priority (highlighted: true).
- Artifact Build & Delivery Checks: Verifies that generate_document output exists with a non-zero byte size, confirms cloud storage upload status (status: "uploaded"), and validates that the attachment link is surfaced in the response.

**Failure behaviour**

If a check fails, pop up a message in the dashboard indicating the issue.
